correctness.rationale: Exact Fourier-Bessel decomposition reduces the fourth power to nonnegative matrix Mkl of Bessel fourth cross moments. Legendre-Plancherel proves M0k=1/[pi(2k+1)] for ALL k, and gives M11=7/(15pi). Xu arXiv:2610.19648 Theorem 1.2 proves Mkk decreases strictly for all k. Cauchy-Schwarz then establishes all cross-term bounds and strictness for any degree >=2; collecting energies A0=(1-b)A and Aplus=bA yields precisely 1-4b/3+4b²/5. All equality cases are exactly H0+H1; zero function separately. The packaged checker passed 4,424 exact-rational assertions and is supplemental rather than an infinite proof.
